name: pve-sentinel
description: pve-sentinel is an LLM-driven security advisory agent for Proxmox VE. It aggregates NVD, MITRE, and Proxmox PVE-SA advisories into a unified CVE feed, scans the Proxmox host and its LXC containers for vulnerable packages, and provides guardrail-constrained remediation guidance through an interactive CLI.

notes.text: Requires a Proxmox API token with least-privilege ACLs. See docs/proxmox-acl.md in the project repository for the exact role, privileges, and pveum commands.
LLM advisory chat is unavailable until an OpenCode API key is provided (var_opencode_api_key). CVE scanning works without it.
verify_ssl is set to false for Proxmox VE's default self-signed CA. For production, install a standards-compliant certificate and set verify_ssl: true.
